value.answer: Tomorrow (Tue) in Toronto looks showery and mild. Showers clear out around noon, but there's a risk of thunderstorms through the morning and afternoon, with 10 to 20 mm of rain possible. Wind southwest around 20 km/h, gusting to 40 near noon. High of 24°C, and it drops to about 12°C overnight with a 60% chance of showers still around. Wednesday is cooler, around 19°C with more sun.
